title: Dispute over debunk of a UAP video (booster vs instrumentation pod)

tellings.quote: Blueg guild triple prime. I think according to Jeffrey Krookshank, who I'm in touch with, um who's analyzed this stuff really deeply, apparently Johnson's actually kind of really scared.

related.note: Same subject: the object seen tumbling out of the Bluegill Triple Prime fireball. Here it is debated as a booster versus an instrumentation pod, not an unidentified craft, so the two accounts could not both be right.

plain: A podcast host named Jesse Michels describes an argument over a video called Bluegill Triple Prime, which shows a UAP, the official term for an unidentified flying object, tumbling out of a fireball. Skeptics, including a man named Dean Johnson, explain the object as an ordinary rocket booster or instrument pod, and Michels says that Jeffrey Krookshank, an analyst he is in touch with who has studied the footage closely, believes Johnson is actually quite scared. If the object is not what the skeptics say, the video would show something unexplained.
